guideline.Universal minimum (any live lender): 6+ months in business; $15K+ monthly true revenue (most lenders want $25K+); 500+ FICO; 3+ deposits per month; not in a universally restricted industry
guideline.Sweet spot (most lenders): 12+ months in business; $30K+ monthly revenue; 550+ FICO; 5 or fewer negative days per month; 1st-4th position
guideline.Almost always restricted: Cannabis; auto sales/dealerships; financial services / lenders / brokers; law firms (case by case); open bankruptcy
guideline.Often restricted: Trucking (needs $50K-$100K+/mo or 3+ trucks); construction (higher revenue/TIB); real estate; solar; staffing; non-profits
guideline.Preferred industries (several lenders): Restaurants, retail, medical/healthcare, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, home services, salons, e-commerce, distributors, logistics, nursing homes, franchises
guideline.State notes: Texas and California are excluded by many lenders - route TX to Mint/MMP; North Dakota restricted (Lendini); UT/VA need ~$50K/mo (TMR); NY/CA need 4 months of statements at several lenders
guideline.What the agent can and can't see: Public data shows TIB, location, industry, size proxies and UCC filings. Revenue, FICO, negative days and positions are confirmed only from bank statements and the application - treat agent scores as a pre-qualification, not an approval.
guideline.Outreach compliance: Use opt-in or B2B-permitted channels; follow TCPA for calls/texts (no auto-dialed texts to cell phones without consent) and CAN-SPAM for email; never say 'pre-approved' or 'guaranteed'; Batch is a broker, never 'direct lender'.
guideline.Status key: Live = signed, can submit. Pending = redlines out, don't submit yet. Not signed = do not route. Statuses for lenders/other_lenders: Live, Live (note), Pending (note), In setup, Not signed, Contacted, Passed, Dropped.
